title: docs(site): the top nav never lights on a blog post — posts prerender under /en/blog/SLUG, so the nav's url and nested-url matching against usePathname fails for Blog and for the new Why entry
body:
立卡门 class a — a user-visible defect on the public docs site; reach measured on a production build, with a control.

## What is wrong

The docs site's top nav declares `Blog` with `active: 'nested-url'` and (from PR #22974) `Why` with `active: 'url'` in `apps/docs/lib/layout.shared.tsx`. Neither ever lights on a blog post:

- `GET /blog/context-window-is-the-constraint` serves the `Blog` anchor with `data-active=false`.
- `GET /blog/the-ontology-is-the-software` serves both `Why` and `Blog` with `data-active=false`.
- Control: `GET /blog` serves `Blog` with `data-active=true`.

All three were measured on the production build of PR #22974's branch (base `246edf5b`), in the server HTML and again after hydration; the `Blog` behaviour predates that PR and is unchanged by it.

## Why

`.next/prerender-manifest.json` lists the posts as `/en/blog/SLUG`: they are prerendered under the internal language-prefixed path. fumadocs-ui's `isLinkItemActive` / `isActive` (`dist/utils/urls.js`) compares the link's `url` against `usePathname()`, which during that prerender is `/en/blog/SLUG`, so neither `/blog` (nested-url) nor `/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software` (url) matches, and hydration does not repaint the attribute. `/blog` itself renders on demand with the public path and matches.

## Reach

Every blog post page, every visitor: the nav shows no current section on any post, and the `Why` entry added for the essay never shows as current on the essay. Reported by the developer on #22951 (PR #22974 Acceptance notes) with the measurements above.

## What done looks like

- On a blog post, the nav entry that declares that post (`Why` on the essay; `Blog` on every post via nested-url) renders `data-active=true` in the server HTML and after hydration, with `/blog` still lighting `Blog`.
- Fix surface is `apps/docs` only: either match the nav against the public path (the pathname with the `/en` prefix stripped, or the prerender path made to equal the public one), or prerender the posts under the public path. No fumadocs upgrade is assumed; no gate is added.
- A measurement in the PR like the one above, with the control.

Dedupe words: nav active, nested-url, data-active, prerender /en/blog, usePathname.

## Who acts

domain:devx lane (inherited from the in-flight parent #22951, where the finding was reported). Awaiting first grading as a finding.

## Duplicate check (2026-10-12, open and closed)

- Query "docs site nav active state blog post nested-url data-active prerender en blog usePathname lang prefix": 1 hit — #12233 (single-segment dotted paths soft-404, closed), unrelated.
